name: btn: Invoice Open In QBO
purpose: Opens the Invoice in QuickBooks: builds {Entity: Invoice, QBOId: SalesTransaction::qbo_id} and calls karbon_LedgerLink 'Open in QB' (501).
open_question: Script 300 is the same with Entity SalesReceipt; two near-identical scripts. Called from layouts Invoice, Invoice View Only and SalesReceipt.

name: btn: SalesReceipt Open In QBO
purpose: Opens the SalesReceipt in QuickBooks: builds {Entity: SalesReceipt, QBOId: SalesTransaction::qbo_id} and calls karbon_LedgerLink 'Open in QB' (501).

name: btn: Refresh From QBO
purpose: Refreshes a sales transaction from QBO: passes SalesTransaction::qbo_id to 'Refresh SalesReceipt From QBO ( qbo_id )' (299).
open_question: Name says 'SalesReceipt' even for invoices; script is in the Scripts menu. Callers: none found.

name: btn: Remove Sales Transaction From QBO
purpose: Deletes a sales transaction from QuickBooks Online: calls karbon_kontroller 'Delete a SalesTransaction From QBO { data }' (461) with the transaction Id; shows the error as a dialog when it fails; refreshes the window.
